parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order. Default: Asc. Valid values:

*   Asc: Ascending order.
*   Desc: Descending order.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default: 10. Maximum: 100.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The sort field. Default value: CreateTime. Valid values:

*   CreateTime: Creation time. Supported only for MaxCompute tables.
*   ModifyTime: Modification time. Supported only for MaxCompute tables.
*   Name: Name. Used for HMS-type tables.
*   RecordCount: Record count. Supported only for MaxCompute tables.
*   DataSize: Storage size. Supported only for MaxCompute tables.

parameters.name: TableId
parameters.description: The ID of the data table.You can refer to the ListTables API response and [Concepts related to metadata entities](~~2880092~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public list-partitions --table-id maxcompute-table:::project_name:_schema_name_:table_name --name ds=20250101 --sort-by CreateTime --order Asc --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
